headline: KZN Duster stock is thin on fairly-priced automatics, but the sweet spot is the 2022 TechRoad auto at KIA Ballito (R249,900, 47k km, ~R12k under model), with the R209,990 2022 Zen the market's standout bargain if a manual is acceptable.

shortlist.note: Best overall match: 2022 TechRoad auto diesel, 47,051 km, R249,900 (~R12,185 under model) at KIA Ballito — trade-in friendly dealer, ticks every box.
Standout bargain: 2022 Zen diesel at R209,990 is ~R24,273 under model and the cheapest 2020+ diesel in KZN here; manual is the only compromise.
2023 Zen, 44,460 km, R244,900 (~R12,761 under) at Durban Multifranchise KIA — newest, lowest-km value play and ideal trade-in partner; manual.
Top-spec 2023 Intens auto diesel, 86,000 km, R259,900 (~R7,622 under) at GWM Haval Mobeni — the pick if Intens trim + auto matter more than price; km is high-ish.
